meanings.en: to wait until something happens, to get by waiting (+ genitive)
meanings.note: Wait for an outcome. Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'ждаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to wait for, to live to see', paired with 'дожидаться'.
